title: Closed in-memory JSON Schema registry
x-semantic-rules: Entry schema_id values and case-folded paths are unique. Each schema's embedded $id equals schema_id and each canonical byte length/hash equals the entry.

The entry set is exactly the transitive closure of every normative schema referenced by the plan, catalog, fixtures, vectors, evidence, reviews, journal, release and runtime contracts; no orphan normative schema and no undeclared dependency is allowed.
All external $ref values use a complete registered URN. Relative external references, retrieval callbacks, network access and ambient CWD lookup fail before instance validation.
registry_tree_sha256 hashes the entries sorted by schema_id using RFC 8785 JCS and excludes only registry_tree_sha256 itself.
